review_scope: Static source-only comparison of the AllThree result-capture reader with the then-current conditional CPU verifier producer template. No imports, tests, queries, remote access, or payload reads.

finding.consequence: The reader's launch identity predicate necessarily rejects the producer's launch object after all five support receipt constants are bound. The reader checks these fields before systemd/cgroup/GPU queries, so the mismatch can be fixed in the producer schema before any capture attempt.
finding.source_evidence: Reader RESULT_CAPTURE_TEMPLATE.py launch predicate in main(); producer REMOTE_SUBMISSION_TEMPLATE.py launch object written after systemd-run submission.

required_resolution: Update and statically review the producer launch record to include the exact support invocation ID observed after submission, native unit, and native invocation ID; preserve the exact systemd observation and uncertain submission outcomes in that durable record. Reconcile the final producer pin against the unchanged reader before binding any actual support receipts.
